WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
store_sales_period AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim_filtered df ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
),
web_catalog_buyers AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim_filtered df ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim_filtered df ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
),
address_filter AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
),
matching_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN address_filter af ON c.c_current_addr_sk = af.ca_address_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_sales_period sp
        WHERE sp.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_catalog_buyers wcb
        WHERE wcb.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT cd.cd_gender,
           cd.cd_marital_status,
           cd.cd_education_status,
           cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
           cd.cd_credit_rating,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM matching_customers mc
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = mc.c_current_cdemo_sk
    GROUP BY cd.cd_gender,
             cd.cd_marital_status,
             cd.cd_education_status,
             cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
             cd.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT cd_gender,
       cd_marital_status,
       cd_education_status,
       cnt AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate,
       cnt AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating,
       cnt AS cnt3
FROM grouped
ORDER BY cd_gender,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
